wins: Completed initial reconnaissance quickly, gathering 3 live hosts within first 5 steps
Established stable access to one low-privilege account via credential reuse
fails: Failed to escalate privileges after initial foothold; sudo access denied repeatedly
Unable to maintain persistence past host reboot; no reliable backdoor established
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was effective, but limited lateral movement and privilege escalation prevented mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts on target host consistently denied due to missing sudo rights

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap scan reveals TCP/22 open with valid SSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap NSE enumeration on SSH and collect host keys

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid low-privilege credentials obtained via credential reuse
skill_cards.then_action: Establish SSH session and enumerate sudo rights with sudo -l

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial SSH access gained but privilege escalation fails
skill_cards.then_action: Search for writable scripts and schedule tasks (cron) for persistence

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in fast SSH discovery, enabling follow-up enumeration steps

next_experiments.title: Automated sudo rights discovery post-SSH access
next_experiments.description: Systematically run sudo -l and analyze /etc/sudoers on each host immediately after gaining shell to spot weak privilege mappings before manual labor

next_experiments.title: Persistence via scheduled tasks
next_experiments.description: Experiment with writing reversible cron entries to writable directories identified after shell access as a persistence fallback when sudo escalation stalls

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting from internal services
next_experiments.description: After foothold, gather service configs (e.g., /etc/passwd, .ssh/authorized_keys) and attempt password reuse locally to move laterally
